questions.text:
The first farmed carrots
weren't orange
questions.say: True or false? The first farmed carrots weren't orange
questions.fact: Early carrots were purple or yellow

questions.text:
White chocolate has
no cocoa butter
questions.say: True or false? White chocolate has no cocoa butter
questions.fact: Cocoa butter is its main ingredient

questions.say: True or false? Bananas grow on trees
questions.fact: The plant is a giant herb; its 'trunk' is rolled leaves

questions.say: True or false? Apples float in water
questions.fact: About a quarter of an apple is air

questions.text:
Salt makes pasta water
boil much faster
questions.say: True or false? Salt makes pasta water boil much faster
questions.fact: Salt actually raises the boiling point a tiny bit
